title: No unapproved dependencies
objective: Allow only dependencies on the approved register; fail the build when a new direct or transitive dependency appears without an intake decision.
implementing_systems: Praxis CI workflow (exists for tool repositories)

title: Locked, hash-verified dependency restore and pinned build inputs
objective: Restore dependencies only from committed lockfiles with integrity hashes in locked mode, pin CI actions to full commit SHAs and container images to digests.
implementing_systems: MSBuild/NuGet locked restore (not verified as enabled)
npm ci with package-lock.json (Limen has a lockfile)
residual_risks: Observed workflows pin some actions by SHA (attest-build-provenance) and others by tag (actions/checkout@v6); pinning is inconsistent.

title: SBOM generated in the build for every release
objective: Generate an SPDX or CycloneDX SBOM from the resolved build graph for every release artifact, attach and sign it, and make it available to customers.
notes: 2026-11-25 refinement-agent: framework_refs: replaced superseded SRC-NTIA-SBOM-MIN with SRC-CISA-SBOM-MIN.

title: VEX for reported component vulnerabilities
objective: Assess each vulnerability reported against an included component and publish a VEX status with justification within a defined time.

title: Hosted, isolated builds with signed provenance
objective: Build release artifacts only on a hosted, ephemeral build service from version-controlled definitions, and emit signed SLSA provenance for each artifact.
implementing_systems: actions/attest-build-provenance (used in Praxis, Limen, Strata release workflows)
residual_risks: SLSA Build L3 requires hardened, isolated builders and non-forgeable provenance; reusable-workflow isolation has not been assessed.
Applies only to tool releases; no product build exists.

title: Verify signatures and provenance before deployment
objective: Refuse to deploy any artifact whose signature and provenance do not match the expected repository, workflow and builder.
implementing_systems: gh attestation verify (used in Limen publish workflow)

title: Protection against malicious and confused packages
objective: Use package source mapping and private feeds to prevent dependency confusion, disable or review npm install scripts, check new packages against malicious-package advisories, and apply a cooling-off period for newly published versions.
implementing_systems: NuGet.config package source mapping (Praxis has a NuGet.config; mapping not verified)

title: License policy enforcement
objective: Evaluate every component license against policy in the build, block prohibited licenses, route review-required licenses to approval, and generate attribution notices.

title: Upstream health and own-repository hardening
objective: Assess critical dependencies' maintenance and security practices (OpenSSF Scorecard and manual review) at intake and periodically, and run Scorecard on Echelon's own repositories with remediation of failing checks.
residual_risks: Scorecard measures observable practices, not code quality or maintainer intent.
